info.text:
Confidence jumped 7.5 points, but one number still flashes red.
The Conference Board's consumer confidence index rose to 91.7 in October 2026, from a revised 84.2 in September.
That's the highest since June and far above the 81 economists expected (Bloomberg survey).
But the expectations index is 72.6, below the 80 level the Conference Board links to possible recession.
12-month inflation expectations: 5.8%. Consumers planned to spend less on services and durable goods.
Sources: The Conference Board (Oct 27, 2026), Bloomberg, Quartz.
News and education, not financial advice.
